# useScrollPosition

> Lightweight hooks for scroll position detection

## Docs

- [Get started](/use-scroll-position/getting-started): Need reliable scroll data for `animations`, `lazy loading`, or `sticky UI`?
- [useBodyScrollPosition](/use-scroll-position/use-body-scroll-position): Just like <b>useWindowScrollPosition</b>, <b>useBodyScrollPosition</b> lets you track scrolling — but under the hood it uses a different method to detect position.
- [useOverflowScrollPosition](/use-scroll-position/use-overflow-scroll-position): `useOverflowScrollPosition` is a React hook for tracking the scroll position inside a scrollable container with `overflow`.
It returns two ref setters:
- [useWindowScrollPosition](/use-scroll-position/use-window-scroll-position): Lets you track scrolling on the `global page`. It returns a `callback` that can be passed as a `ref` to any child element. When used this way, it tracks the scroll position of that element instead of the `window`.
